explanation_short: XGBoost is recommended because it minimizes prediction errors more effectively than other models.
explanation_full: While Random Forest and Gradient Boosting also achieve high R² values (0.99), XGBoost demonstrates superior performance in error metrics (MAE, RMSE, MAPE). This consistent outperformance suggests that XGBoost is better at minimizing prediction errors, making it the optimal choice.
